sloka: या मेरु दुहिता राम तयोर् माता सुमध्यमा ।नाम्ना मेना मनोज्ञा वै पत्नी हिमवतः प्रिया ॥१-३५-१५॥
transliteration: yā meru duhitā rāma tayor mātā sumadhyamā ।nāmnā menā manojñā vai patnī himavataḥ priyā ॥1-35-15॥

translations.english: O Rama Himavan's beloved of beautiful waist, wellknown by the name of Manorama is the daughter of Mount Meru. She is the mother to both the daughters.
